primary_sources_read.sections_read: Published 2024/volume2025, Definitions and Questions5.1–5.2 retain both thesis rotation targets. General d≥4 counterexamples and stronger continuous-selection counterexamples do not settle these two questions.
Definitions of strong shuffles and final Questions4.2–4.4; exact single starting pair result is different from uniformity or reachability for all starting tuples.

Published2025/v3October23,2025, definitions and concluding problems: t-reachability uses the fixed starting tuple, not all starting tuples. Its single-pair2n−3 uniformity conjecture is explicitly marked solved by Janzer et al.

Published2024 definitions and final Problems11–12 retain leading constants and arbitrary multi-infection classification. Θ(n^r) is proved for ordinary complete-hypergraph processes, not the requested constants or full multi-infection family.

August31,2026 version2: general running-time upper bound using Turán density π(F−e), and a nontrivial clique upper constant. Bounds do not give matching general leading constants or arbitrary multi-infection classification.

accepted.title: Disconnected placements in a three-dimensional convex Kakeya body
accepted.text: A compact convex set K⊂R^d is S-Kakeya if, for every ρ∈SO(d), some w∈R^d satisfies ρS+w⊂K. Two placements (ρ₀,w₀),(ρ₁,w₁) connect within K if continuous paths ρ:[0,1]→SO(d), w:[0,1]→R^d join them and satisfy ρ(t)S+w(t)⊂K throughout. Do there exist nonempty compact convex S,K⊂R³ such that K is S-Kakeya and two placements of S in K cannot connect within K?

accepted.title: Nearly linear exact shuffles for every fixed tuple size
accepted.text: A lazy transposition on [n] independently applies a specified swap (a,b) with a specified probability p∈[0,1], and otherwise does nothing. Let U_k^all(n) be the minimum length of one sequence of independent lazy transpositions whose product sends every ordered tuple of k distinct starting elements to the uniform distribution on all (n)_k=n(n−1)⋯(n−k+1) ordered distinct tuples. For every fixed positive integer k and every ε>0, is U_k^all(n)=O_(k,ε)(n^(1+ε)) as n→∞?
accepted.subject: Combinatorics & Graph Theory

accepted.text: For fixed k≥1, let R_k^all(n) be the minimum length of one sequence of independent lazy transpositions on [n] whose product sends every ordered tuple of k distinct starting elements to every ordered tuple of k distinct destinations with positive probability. Determine R_k^all(n) exactly or to leading asymptotic order as n→∞, with no restriction that swaps share a common endpoint.

accepted.title: Leading constants for clique bootstrap running times
accepted.text: Fix integers k>r≥2. On vertex set [n], start with any set of infected r-element edges. In each parallel round infect every edge belonging to a copy of the complete r-uniform hypergraph K_k^(r) that is missing at most one edge; retain previous infections. Let M_k^r(n) be the maximum, over all initial infections, of the number of rounds until no further edge is infected. For each fixed k>r≥2, does lim_(n→∞) M_k^r(n)/n^r exist, and if so what is its value?
accepted.subject: Combinatorics & Graph Theory

accepted.title: Maximum running times of multi-edge clique infections
accepted.text: For fixed integers k>r≥2 and 1≤m≤binom(k,r), start with any infected r-element edges on [n]. In each parallel round, for every k-vertex set currently missing at most m of its r-element edges, infect all those missing edges. Let M_(K_k^(r),m)(n) be the maximum number of rounds until stabilization over all initial infections. Determine its asymptotic growth as n→∞ for every fixed triple (k,r,m).
